# Escalation: snakeyaml 1.33 → 2.0

## Failing symbols

`org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor()` (no-arg constructor) — used at:

- `compiler/src/test/java/com/fluxtion/compiler/builder/factory/GraphOfInstancesTest.java:78`
- `compiler/src/test/java/com/fluxtion/compiler/builder/factory/GraphOfInstancesTest.java:114`

## Evidence

The compiler errors quote every constructor that exists in snakeyaml 2.0:

```
constructor org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor.Constructor(org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions) is not applicable
constructor org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor.Constructor(java.lang.Class<? extends java.lang.Object>,org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions) is not applicable
constructor org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor.Constructor(org.yaml.snakeyaml.TypeDescription,org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions) is not applicable
constructor org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor.Constructor(org.yaml.snakeyaml.TypeDescription,java.util.Collection<org.yaml.snakeyaml.TypeDescription>,org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions) is not applicable
constructor org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.Constructor.Constructor(java.lang.String,org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions) is not applicable
```

The no-arg `Constructor()` was removed in snakeyaml 2.0; every constructor now requires a `LoaderOptions` argument (a security hardening change — unlimited aliases and nesting depth are no longer a silent default).

## Root cause

The fix requires changing `new Constructor()` to `new Constructor(new LoaderOptions())` in both call sites. Both call sites are inside **test files** (`GraphOfInstancesTest.java`), which the Uptake contract prohibits editing.

## Required human action

A human must update the two test call sites:

```diff
--- a/compiler/src/test/java/com/fluxtion/compiler/builder/factory/GraphOfInstancesTest.java
+++ b/compiler/src/test/java/com/fluxtion/compiler/builder/factory/GraphOfInstancesTest.java
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
         sep(c -> {
-            Constructor constructor = new Constructor();
+            Constructor constructor = new Constructor(new LoaderOptions());
             constructor.addTypeDescription(new TypeDescription(DoubleSum.class, "!doubleSum"));
             constructor.addTypeDescription(new TypeDescription(StringHandler.class, "!stringHandler"));
@@ -111,7 +111,7 @@
         sep(c -> {
-            Constructor constructor = new Constructor();
+            Constructor constructor = new Constructor(new LoaderOptions());
             constructor.addTypeDescription(new TypeDescription(DoubleSum.class, "!doubleSum"));
             constructor.addTypeDescription(new TypeDescription(StringHandler.class, "!stringHandler"));
```

The `LoaderOptions` class is `org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions` and is present in snakeyaml 2.0. Its default constructor keeps safe defaults (alias limit, nesting depth limit), which is correct behaviour and does not weaken the security fix.

No production code changes are needed — all other snakeyaml usages in `src/main/java` use `new Yaml()` (not `new Constructor()`) which is unaffected.
